instructions.text: Heat a non-stick pan and lightly spray with cooking spray. 1 Multi-seed Sandwich Thin 40g Avocado Salt & Pepper Chilli Flakes (Optional) Spray & Cook
Chop the mushrooms, spinach, and baby tomatoes, then add them to the pan. Season and saut‚ until soft, then remove from the pan and set aside.
Respray the pan, return to medium heat, and add the chicken rashers. Flip after 3 minutes, allowing each side to crisp and cook through.
Using egg rings, crack the eggs directly into the pan alongside the rashers. Cook until the whites are set and the yolks reach your preferred doneness. Remove from the pan.
Toast the multiseed sandwich thin until golden brown.
Spread the avocado evenly over the toasted bread and season.
Layer with the saut‚ed veggies, crispy chicken rashers, and pan-fried eggs.
Serve and enjoy! Pro {p: use a non-s+ick egg ring 40 make perfec+ly round pan fried eggs/ asy subs: Swap chicken rashers for 1+09 lean round cu+ bacon
